description: postil: remind a listening session of submitted reviews, and keep it from stopping with review threads unanswered. Silent in every other session.

hooks.command: command -v postil >/dev/null 2>&1 && postil hook session-start || true
command -v postil >/dev/null 2>&1 && postil hook prompt || true
command -v postil >/dev/null 2>&1 && postil hook stop || true
